Name: Nanami Custom NPC - EXPANDED DIALOGUE
Author: AylaGames
Description:
[size=6][center][color=#ff0000][b][u]THIS MOD IS NO LONGER BEING WORKED ON[/u][/b]
[size=4]I will no longer update this for any reason unless it is broken.
[/size][/color][color=#cc0000][size=4][/size][/color][size=3][u]You do not have my permission to edit or publish my dialogue expansion without my consent.[/u][/size][/center][/size]


[url=https://imgbb.com/][img]https://i.ibb.co/jWz7SXY/W4lVEIj.png[/img]
[/url]This mod was designed to add a lot of dialogue to Nanamis' current dialogue.

Right now, there are close to 100 lines of brand-new dialogue. I tried to keep the tone with the existing dialogue, as well as making the new dialogue sound lore friendly. [b][u]There is suggestive dialogue and some cursing.[/u][/b]

My mod is simply just a dialogue mod, if there are any problems with the schedule, animation etc that is not something I can fix, that would be left up to the mod author, [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/OurpleKay/about-me?gameId=1303]OurpleKay[/url].

Also, just because I am no longer working on this mod doesn't mean it is 100% abandoned. If you report a bug I will investigate. 


[url=https://imgbb.com/][img]https://i.ibb.co/D5MXycm/manual-installation.png[/img][/url]
[color=#e69138][u]Sav[/u][u]ing the original dialogue files is highly recommended just in case if you delete this mod one day.[/u][/color][b]

[/b]1. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]Smapi[/url]: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400
2. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915
3. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url]: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348
4. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23552]Nanami Custom NPC[/url]: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23552
5. Unzip Nanami mod into Stardew Valley Mods folder in your files.
6. Install this mod and copy files over to the inside of the Nanami mod and [b][u]overwrite[/u][/b] the files in there.



[url=https://imgbb.com/][img]https://i.ibb.co/rfs6XSQ/stardrop-installation.png[/img][/url]

1. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]Smapi[/url]: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400
2. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915
3. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url]: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348
4. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23552]Nanami Custom NPC[/url]: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23552
5. Install my mod as you would any other mod, but when the prompt comes up and says  'A previous version of [insert your selected Nanami dialogue] has been detected. Would you like to clear the previous install?' [b]You must click 'Yes'[/b], not 'Yes to All'.

Install Nanami first and then when install my mod click [b]'Yes'. [/b]Clicking 'Yes to All' will basically erase Nanami out of existence, and we both don't want to see that again, so make sure you click 'Yes' when installing my mod.



[url=https://imgbb.com/][img]https://i.ibb.co/WkxLx2f/credits.png[/img]
[/url]Thank you to the amazing [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/OurpleKay/about-me?gameId=1303]OurpleKay[/url] for making this Nanami mod and giving people the chance to continue to have Nanami in our lives and letting him be happy.
